description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that implements a hearing range measurement app. It handles onboarding, tone generation, user responses, and presenting results for a hearing test. The class manages UI components, handles permissions, synthesizes tones, and processes user input.
external_methods: build.gradle dependencies for androidx, material design, and media

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for hearing range measurement app, managing UI flow, tone playback, user responses, and result presentation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, binds UI components, sets up onboarding, and requests permissions.

methods.name: setupOnboarding
methods.description: Configures the onboarding UI and start button.

methods.name: startHearingTest
methods.description: Resets test state and begins the hearing test sequence.

methods.name: updateTestStep
methods.description: Updates UI for the current test frequency, sets up tone playback and response buttons.

methods.name: playPureTone
methods.description: Synthesizes and plays a sine wave tone at specified frequency using AudioTrack.

methods.name: showFinalResult
methods.description: Displays summarized hearing range based on user responses.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles user's permission response and warns if permission is denied.
